findings.title: Credentials written to logs
findings.why: The password is sent to console output and can leak into provider logs.
findings.fix: Remove the log or redact sensitive fields.

findings.title: SQL injection in login
findings.why: String interpolation lets input alter the authentication query.
findings.fix: Use the database client's parameterized lookup.

findings.title: Unreachable response
findings.why: The newly returned token makes the original return unreachable.
findings.fix: Return one deliberate, tested response shape.

findings.title: Missing security regression tests
findings.why: No test asserts passwords are not logged or hostile input is rejected.
findings.fix: Add tests for injection-like input and redacted logging.
